name: Waterproof War Paint Kit
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 1st; Slot none; Price 500 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This long, narrow tin is divided into sections for five different colors of face paint. Included in each kit are black, white, red, green, and blue. The paint is specially enhanced to give the wearer a fierce appearance. All non-allies who fail their Will saves upon seeing a creature wearing the paint will be shaken for 1 round (but will not be shaken again by seeing the same creatures for 24 hours). Superior to homemade paints, the pigments in this kit are waterproof, and will not easily wear off. Unless purposefully be removed with soap and water or animal fat, the paint will not wear off for a full 24 hours, regardless of how wet it gets. The kit contains enough paint for ten uses.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Item, war paint; Cost 250 gp.
